publication.standfirst: My first love was investigative journalism. One of the most difficult things about the daily grind as a journalist is creating work you can be proud of forever. Here’s some of mine.

blurbs.spare-the-child: Amy Bril grew up in the Children of God, the cult now called the Family. As her divorce heads to court, she and her husband disagree about whether the group has anything to do with it, and about where their three children should grow up.
blurbs.roll-player: Charles Monson, a quadriplegic, drives to rehab centers to help severely disabled patients fight their health plan for the power wheelchairs it keeps denying.
blurbs.sparring-with-shadows: A year after the suicide of coach Jeremy Williams, Orange County’s first professional mixed-martial-arts team is still fighting. His parents remember the son who handed his money to a stranger on the street.
blurbs.get-in-the-cage: Three weeks before the biggest fight of his career, Irvine’s Quinton “Rampage” Jackson trains near Big Bear Lake, trying to turn a following in Japan into a household name in America.
blurbs.house-of-pain: Arther Masaoka fought Tustin for years over his house, and lost. Even the lawyer who used to represent him calls him “a total jerk,” then adds that what happened to him was wrong.
blurbs.chicken-babies-bondage-nights: Richard Johnson drives a cab, runs an art gallery, and hosts a bondage night. He will talk about all of it, except the one thing everyone asks about.
blurbs.against-the-wall: Praying, eating and bowling with the most hated student group at UC Irvine, a group so wary of the press that its president asked me to stop interviewing members until he had spoken with me.
blurbs.did-crimes-kamran-mashayekhi-witnessed-p: Kamran Mashayekhi, 66, says crimes he witnessed as a cab driver have put him on a hit list. Some in law enforcement aren’t so sure.
blurbs.did-alleged-attack-on-self-described-sni: Evidence seems to support Kamran Mashayekhi’s story of being attacked in a Buena Park garage. But did it happen for the reasons he says?
blurbs.corpus-christi-canceled-at-chapman: A chapel dean at Chapman University cancels a play about a “gay Jesus” that he hasn’t seen or read. The production finds a new home at a nearby church.
blurbs.garden-grove-officer-union-promotion: Officer Mark Hutchinson alleges Garden Grove pushed him off the job after nearly 25 years because he fought for higher wages and pensions as police union president.
blurbs.hurts-so-good: Norma Jean Riddick, 40, a former dominatrix turned standup comedian in Costa Mesa, walks us through the underworld of fetishes and masochism.
blurbs.counsel-bluffs: A client paid John Hedderman $3,000 in cash and a $3,000 check to handle her custody case. The DA says he wasn’t just a bad lawyer. The DA says he wasn’t a lawyer at all.
blurbs.the-tale-of-no-tape: Naui Huitzilopochtli has been pepper-sprayed, kicked and threatened for filming rallies. Then, he says, Garden Grove police shook him down for it.
